title: The restriction map to degree-zero Čech cohomology is invertible
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $U_i$ an open cover ($\sup_i U_i=X$), and $F$ any abelian sheaf [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. The canonical restriction map $F(X)\to\check H^0(U,F)$ is an isomorphism, including empty and infinite covers.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, zero-row restriction identification; source CechCohomology.lean:181-203

proof.text: Use the proved source isIso_toCechCohomologyZero_app. The homology projection is invertible in degree zero. The sheaf gluing theorem identifies restriction families with zero cocycles, and separatedness proves injectivity. The Fin-1 tuple intersections themselves cover X, so empty covers are included.
